description: This file defines a set of classes and GLSL shader effects for a Kivy widget called EffectWidget, which applies graphical effects to its children using OpenGL shaders and frame buffer objects (Fbo). It includes effect classes, shader code snippets, and the EffectWidget implementation for managing effects and rendering.

classes.name: EffectBase
classes.description: Base class for GLSL effects, managing shader code and Fbo association.

classes.name: AdvancedEffectBase
classes.description: Extension of EffectBase with support for uniform variables updates.

classes.name: MonochromeEffect
classes.description: Effect that converts input colors to grayscale.

classes.name: ChannelMixEffect
classes.description: Effect that swaps or repeats color channels based on 'order' property.

classes.name: PixelateEffect
classes.description: Effect that pixelates the input based on 'pixel_size'.

classes.name: HorizontalBlurEffect
classes.description: Effect that applies horizontal Gaussian blur with adjustable 'size'.

classes.name: VerticalBlurEffect
classes.description: Effect that applies vertical Gaussian blur with adjustable 'size'.

classes.name: EffectFbo
classes.description: Extended Fbo class with method to set fragment shader.

classes.name: EffectWidget
classes.description: Kivy widget that applies a sequence of graphical effects to its children using multiple Fbo instances and shaders.

methods.name: set_fbo_shader
methods.description: Sets the Fbo's fragment shader by splicing the GLSL code.

methods.name: _load_from_source
methods.description: Loads GLSL shader code from a source file.

methods.name: _update_uniforms
methods.description: Updates uniform variables in the shader from the 'uniforms' dictionary.

methods.name: do_glsl
methods.description: Generates GLSL code for effects based on properties.

methods.name: refresh_fbo_setup
methods.description: Creates and manages Fbo instances for each effect, handling resizing and shader setup.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a child widget to the EffectWidget, rendering it into the Fbo.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a child widget from the EffectWidget.

methods.name: clear_widgets
methods.description: Clears all child widgets from the EffectWidget.

methods.name: _refresh_background_color
methods.description: Updates the background color of the Fbo.

methods.name: _update_glsl
methods.description: Updates shader uniforms 'time' and 'resolution' each frame.
